authority_effect: frozen history only; replay has none
commands: vela init <repository> --name "Bounded heterogeneous evidence lifecycle" --scope "What exact median follows from the retained five-row calibration fixture?" --json

vela verification check verification/exact-method.json --profile deterministic-tabular-recompute-v1 --property exact_recomputation --as verifier:exact-recompute --does-not-establish "Instrument accuracy, representativeness, causal inference, scientific acceptance, or Standing." --json

vela verification record . vpr_ca75cd93988142d0 --profile deterministic-tabular-recompute-v1 --method verification/exact-method.json --property exact_recomputation --outcome pass --does-not-establish "Instrument accuracy, representativeness, causal inference, scientific acceptance, or Standing." --independent-of agent:evidence-producer --output evidence/result.json --as verifier:exact-recompute --json
vela review inbox . --json # blocked: evidence_scope_review is still missing

vela verification record . vpr_ca75cd93988142d0 --profile bounded-evidence-review-v1 --method verification/scope-method.json --property evidence_scope_review --outcome pass --does-not-establish "Independent measurement, instrument calibration, external validity, scientific acceptance, or Standing." --independent-of agent:evidence-producer --output evidence/scope-review.md --as verifier:evidence-scope --json

vela review accept . vpr_ca75cd93988142d0 --if-entry-root sha256:8c1a23115efeb06ac15444c888f50f264c24df39fa6673be3278fb9dbcf10375 --reason "Exact recomputation and the separate evidence-scope review pass; accept only the median over these retained fixture rows." --as human:fixture-reviewer --session-ref external-heterogeneous-evidence-fixture --json
